concerns.text: Functional Requirement FR-006 (calculate ΔR² between composition‑only and structure‑aware models) has no corresponding task. The current tasks only produce a composition‑vs‑Random‑Forest baseline (delta_vs_rf) and a stub for structure‑aware graph construction, but no task generates the required structure‑aware model or the ΔR² performance gap.

Success Criterion SC-002 (measure the ΔR² information‑loss gap between composition‑only and structure‑aware models) is uncovered. No task in the list creates the structure‑aware model results or computes the ΔR² metric, leaving this criterion untestable.
